hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that implements a constant-product bonding curve priced in IMD tokens. Swaps on launched token pools (ETH/coin) are fully consumed in beforeSwap: the ETH leg routes through a canonical ETH/IMD pool, and the IMD proceeds price the coin against a per-coin virtual reserve curve. Creator fees (ETH) and burn fees (IMD) are applied on each trade.
